description: Create a document (File > New, Preset Details) with a size in pixels, resolution, colour mode, bit depth, background fill, pixel aspect ratio and optional colour profile, optionally as an artboard document

artboard.description: Create the document with an artboard (the New Document Artboards option). Default false

pixelAspectRatio.description: Pixel width over height for video work, e.g. 0.9 for D1/DV NTSC. Default 1 (square)

name: create_document
title: Create Document
